C1832.title: Alipay Real-Name Authentication Flagged for Vulnerability: Main Accounts Found Linked to Unknown Sub-Accounts
C1832.summary: In October 2015, an Alipay user reported that five unknown sub-accounts had been linked to their real-name-authenticated account without any confirmation or notification. Since one real-name account could link up to five sub-accounts that shared identity information and could not be unlinked, the issue raised concerns over account takeover and online loan risks. Alipay later responded that real-name authentication required multi-factor verification and processed the unknown accounts. The incident exposed weaknesses in identity verification within account-linking mechanisms.
